content.text:
The robot reached the green panel at the end of the corridor and is now resting (crouched, motors off). The panel fills the camera view directly ahead, about 0.3–0.7 m away.

The route was not a straight corridor. I walked 4 m straight ahead, but that ended at a plain gray wall with no panel. From there I found the panel down a passage to the left. I turned left 90° and walked toward it, sidestepping once around an obstacle. Collision protection stopped the robot several times, so the final approach was in small steps.

The final rest pose shows the right sonar reading 0.25 m and the left 0.65 m, so the robot is not quite centred between the walls. The panel is the stopping point, not the centre of the passage.
